items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Sondernutzung permit
items.quote: Dafür haben Sie einen Monat Zeit, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 13 Apr 2027, sent by ordinary post. Per the letter's own clause ('Einen Bescheid, den wir mit der Post schicken, behandelt das Gesetz am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben'), deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) occurs on the 4th day after posting = Sat 17 Apr 2027 (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG; this day does not shift for a Saturday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO) starts the next day, 18 Apr 2027, and ends one month later under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on Mon 17 May 2027. That day is Pfingstmontag, a public holiday in Hamburg, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO i.V.m. § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO the deadline shifts to the next business day, Tue 18 May 2027.

warnings: The letter mentions the requested usage period 03.05.–28.05.2027 for the container, but this is the applicant's own requested dates, not a deadline set by the authority, and the permit for this period was explicitly refused.

No fee or payment is demanded in this letter despite an IBAN being printed in the footer; that IBAN is the authority's general account and is not linked to any payment obligation here — do not send money based on this letter.
